body:
M4.1 patch 1 on `main` 35931cb (tree identical to rc1 5d9efa6). **Supersedes #69** (yard hens is carried here as ebf3a7a; #69 is left open for the owner to close).

## Commits
| SHA | Summary |
|---|---|
| ebf3a7a | Yard hens: with M4 on, yard sprites = min(hens[H], 12), and #henpill shows hens[H] when > 12 (Hens track). M4 off keeps S.hens(F). The NBSP in the pill is kept. Tests come from #69, with the CCR resolution. |
| 645f12b | S2 asleep signal: targeted port of rc1 AC-R1..R9 (banners, asleep badges, Refill labels and captions, the HUD rate). |
| 49ce43b | sales-stopped-spec §4.2 live-income fix (D-HOP-2026-10-24-13). `demandPerSec` is 0 for a hired, non-paused Market Hand that is Asleep or Unpaid (live path only, `!assumeWorking`). Best-buy and the goal label are unchanged. |
| b0a0266 | Market Hand banner copy per D-HOP-2026-10-24-14 / -17: "Market Hand asleep/unpaid: sales stopped", with aria and role-drop. |
| 3922391 | #scene tap guard: tests plus an rc0 `sceneGuard` check at 360 showing that taps on the banner, Refill and badges don't reach #scene. No stopPropagation was needed. |
| b75a7a2 | Art shots script `scripts/m41-p1-shots.mjs`. |
| d5fc626 | m-RC1-1 (HoQA), CSS only. The `.tracks-exp` entry uses `expin` without scale overshoot, plus an rc0 `mrc1` check. Overlap was 0.257 px before; after, the card is 0.75 px clear. |
| e6a8510 | Coop Hand banner copy per rc1-asleep-state-spec v1.0.6 / rc1-b1-coop-full-spec v1.0.6 (AC-R1c): "Coop Hand asleep/unpaid: collecting stopped", aria "Coop Hand is asleep/unpaid. Auto-collecting has stopped.", role-drop "Asleep/Unpaid: collecting stopped". |
| 4e7a10b | **Bug fix (HoE ruling).** Each banner's effect now comes only from that role's own state, never from the global `salesStopped()`. Before, while the Market Hand was off, other roles read "… production stopped". The HUD aria now adds ", sales stopped" only when the cause is a hired Market Hand that is Asleep or Unpaid (`marketHandStalled`). |
| b2e0405 | D-HOP-29 tests. AC-R8 (v1.0.7): the caption is derived from `manage_prompt_threshold` (the shipping data gives exactly "Rested, refill below 50%", and changing the tunable changes the caption). The frozen Coop Hand copy is tested for text, aria and role-drop only when the full string doesn't fit. Tired is unchanged. |
| e5f5a1b | AC-R7 test: the HUD, the card and the ETA all read the one `incomePerSec` value. |
| b12c8fe, 30b29d3 | Shots script adds Coop Hand asleep/unpaid and Market Hand asleep + Coop Hand unpaid views (each with exact strings, fit and the HUD aria). Unpaid views hire only the role under test, because 0 coins makes every hired worker Unpaid. |

## AC map (rc1-asleep-state-spec v1.0.6 + AC-R8 v1.0.7; rc1-b1-coop-full-spec v1.0.6)
Shot names are `chromium-<view>-<360|390|1280>.png` in the Art shots set.
| AC | Tests | rc0 (3 engines) | Shots |
|---|---|---|---|
| AC-R1 → AC-R1c (Coop Hand asleep: banner + badges = 1) | m41-p1-asleep-signal ("AC-R1 card", "§6 copy … AC-R1c", "asleep Coop Hand drops collect/s; badge counts"); m41-p1-acr8-coop-copy (Coop Hand asleep: text, aria, role-drop); m41-p1-mh-copy | §6 banners 360/390 live states + longest strings (bannerFit, includes the Coop Hand rows) | banner-ch-asleep, banner-ch-asleep-role-dropped, badges-* |
| AC-R1m / AC-B11 / AC-B11u (Market Hand) | m41-p1-mh-copy; m41-p1-live-income; m41-p1-asleep-signal (Market Hand asleep + Coop Hand unpaid) | s28rate (AC-R1m), bannerFit | banner-mh-asleep, banner-mh-unpaid, banner-mh-role-dropped, rate-mh-asleep-zero / -negative |
| AC-R2 (HUD drops the worker's contribution; ≤0 red when it's the only source) | m41-p1-asleep-signal (S2-8 / AC-R2 HUD rate; collect/s drop); m41-p1-live-income (§4.2); m41-p1-acr7 (the worker's own contribution is gone) | s28rate, PM Workers ruling (a) real path | rate-positive, rate-mh-asleep-zero, rate-mh-asleep-negative |
| AC-R3 (Unpaid same as R1/R2) | m41-p1-acr8-coop-copy (Coop Hand unpaid); m41-p1-asleep-signal ("unpaid uses its own row", Market Hand unpaid); m41-p1-mh-copy | §6 banners (Market Hand unpaid live), s28rate (unpaid) | banner-ch-unpaid(-role-dropped), banner-mh-unpaid, banner-mh-asleep-ch-unpaid |
| AC-R4 (Grader "bonus down to 15%") | m41-p1-asleep-signal ("AC-R4: asleep Grader keeps asleep_bonus_share") | §6 banners live states (Grader asleep) | – (copy unchanged from rc1) |
| AC-R5 (clears after Refill/resume; count with 2+) | m41-p1-asleep-signal (badge counts); m41-p1-live-income ("waking the Market Hand restores the old positive rate"); m41-p1-scene-tap-guard (Refill) | s25, sceneGuard | badges-nav-refill, badges-workers-tab-refill, refill-cooldown |
| AC-R6 (no "Manage" string) | m41-p1-asleep-signal ("AC-R6: no player-facing Manage string") | – | – |
| AC-R7 (HUD, card, ETA from one value) | **m41-p1-acr7** (new); m41-p1-asleep-signal (rate text and aria share one token) | dash | rate-* |
| AC-R8 v1.0.7 (T = manage_prompt_threshold × 100 from balance) | **m41-p1-acr8-coop-copy** (shipping data gives exactly "Rested, refill below 50%"; tunables 0.37/0.4/0.5/0.65 change the caption; no literal % in the source); m41-p1-asleep-signal ("AC-R8: greyed caption") | b58 | refill-cooldown, banner-ch-* (per-worker captions recorded in the manifest) |
| AC-R9 (plurals) | m41-p1-asleep-signal ("AC-R9 …" ×2, "ready: Refill + N badge") | s25, b58 | badges-nav-refill, badges-workers-tab-refill |
| AC-B7 (regressions: rc0, S2-8, T6, R1–R9) | full vitest (below) | rc0 394/394 ×3 | – |
| HoE ruling: own-state banners + HUD aria | m41-p1-asleep-signal ("HoE Oct 24 …", "Market Hand asleep + Coop Hand unpaid …", "only the Coop Hand off …") | – | banner-mh-asleep-ch-unpaid, banner-ch-* (the shots script checks the HUD aria) |

### Not in AC, not ported
- **Farm-screen banner.** It is named only in rule text, not in any AC: b1 v1.0.6 says "the card banner and farm banner read …" (line 92), and the surface map says "card/farm banner in patch1" (line 97). The ACs only say "the **card** shows …" (AC-R1, AC-R1m) and "the Asleep banner reads exactly …" (AC-B11 revised, AC-R1c). The card banner covers those ACs, so the farm-screen banner is not ported.
- **Sticky Refill bar height / scroll-margin measure.** No AC in either spec mentions a sticky bar, its height or scroll-margin (string search for "sticky", "scroll-margin" and "Refill bar" finds nothing). AC-R5, AC-R8 and AC-R9 only cover clearing, captions and labels. Not ported.

## HUD aria wording
v1.0.6 (asleep and b1) defines no HUD aria string for an asleep or unpaid worker. The only HUD aria string in b1 is Rule 5 ("Net income minus $1.25 per second. Coop full."), which is for the coop-full state, not built here. The wording ", sales stopped", shown only for a stalled Market Hand, follows the HoE ruling. Examples: "Net income $0.00 per second, sales stopped" and "Net income minus $0.25 per second, sales stopped".

  - `product/workers/rc1-b1-coop-full-spec.md` v1.0.6: sha256 `05fca4368046dd31da8efd56492cbd0ed21dcda06efa63bdce6b1df7c5c82fbd`, sha1 `a2b36af50f6b78901bdde2c3149085a7c0de640b`

- **AC7 flag-off pacing hash.** Produced by the committed `engineering/golden/flagoff-golden.a01faea.test.ts` ("sim trace", `m4.enabled` forced to 0) at 30b29d3: `GOLDEN1 f90d1678c260e1b64c8d1de2afcdaf7608186f37d13ef51970d053b45d349544`, which **equals f90d1678**. The storage-bytes pins (GOLDEN2) are also unchanged.

## Review notes
- **Art:** the refund pop at the coin pill covers `#rate` for 800 ms (shot `rate-during-refund-pop`, with the pop paused at 250 ms).
- **QA:** an Unpaid Market Hand has no Pay action. It resumes on its own once coins cover the wage, so the browser checks for Unpaid run at 0 coins. At 0 coins every hired worker goes Unpaid, so the unpaid shots hire only the role under test.
- **Product:** AC-R8 follows rc1-asleep-state-spec **v1.0.7**. T = `manage_prompt_threshold` × 100 is read from balance, so the shipping data gives "Rested, refill below 50%".
- **Product/QA (observation, unchanged behaviour):** an Unpaid worker above T% energy still shows the "Rested, refill below 50%" caption under a disabled Refill (shot `banner-ch-unpaid`).
- **Product (observation, unchanged model):** at mid-game (L12 / Collection 9), a Coop Hand falling asleep cuts collect/s (75 → 50). The net rate can still go up (+$1.35 → +$1.45/s) because its wage stops while sales aren't limited by collection. The tap model stays per PM Workers ruling (a) / D-HOP-13 (1). AC-R7 holds, since every surface reads the same value.

Supersedes #69.
title: M4.1 patch1: asleep/unpaid signal + yard hens + m-RC1-1
